card.name: Straight apostrophe before s, t, ll
card.fires_on: The straight apostrophe (') that starts a contraction or possessive ending, such as 's, 't, 'll or 've, right after a noun or pronoun like year, sea, can, we, patient or person.

modes.label: Contractions
modes.description: Apostrophe plus t, ll or ve after a verb or pronoun.
modes.example: "He knows smoking isn't good for his health, but he can<<'t>> give it up."

card.writes: It favors curly closing quote marks and suppresses straight quotes and contraction endings, so the output tends toward typographic punctuation.
card.plain: It fires on the apostrophe in words like patient's, can't and we'll.
